jobs.description: Important: This is a contract/part-time role: 10-20 hrs/week - rate $40-50/hr NOPE is an AI safety company with a unique goal; we do not concern ourselves with bio or cyber-risks or other Hollywood-ized alignment fantasies. We are concerned instead with the massive proliferation of relationships between humans and AI and how this affects our wellbeing and societal fabrics. Billions of conversations between people and AI are accumulating into relationships. This ranges children talking to toys, adults with AI companions, or elderly people engaging with healthcare assistants. We measure real conversations and relationships, and the trajectories of risks involved, and publish what we find, so platforms (and society) can decide when and how to act. We build ML models, track incidents, analyze new regulations, and run evaluations constantly on both raw LLMs and deployed AI. We believe you cannot foster safe and aligned AI without proprer governance and scrutiny into AI as it is truly deployed and productized. The eval space in AI is currently heavily oriented to raw LLM evals unfortuntely. We seek to change that. We seek to hold AI labs and products to account for the harms they produce. Our mission is malleable and always changing, and we search for people who seek to help define that. The Social Comms role : We are doing quite a lot but are very limited on social-and-community-driving capacity. The incidents and regulations we track, the whitepapers, plus our evaluations, are all lacking our commentary and voice. We want to increase our social media presence significantly and start to be a more active participant in the global conversation around AI safety and alignment. As our social-comms person you'd take artifacts and research we produce and weave them into a consistent, human presence on the prevalent social channels: deciding what gets posted, writing it, engaging with the researchers, journalists, builders and policymakers already wrestling with these questions. You're a pundit, optimist, skeptic, researcher and writer all rolled into one.Â The measure of your work would be whether the right people are actually engaging: researchers, builders, journalists, policymakers, and the ordinary users who sense something is off. No growth-hacking or engagement bait please. We would rather stay small and authoritative than sound like a brand. The work is async, any timezone, and you'd have direct access to the passionate team and to everything we publish before it's public. You will have a significant say and authorship of our blog (nascent stages still), linkedin, other social accounts, public spaces, and private community spaces that you recommend. Anything relevant to our work. You'd be a great fit if You care deeply about what AI is doing to human relationships and social norms; you're concerned and curious. You understand how LLMs work at an abstract level and the flaws they have. You've run or grown popular social accounts before. You write like a person, and you don't lean on AI to think or post for you. You can read a piece of research and find the three lines people will actually care about. jobs.title: Why do you want this new job
jobs.description: No matter which side of the table youâve sat during interviews, youâve probably heard this question: âWhy do you want this new job?â In the recent past, Iâve interviewed a few candidates and heard the following answers so far: Iâm not learning much on the current job after itâs been 2-4 years. Iâm looking for something that offers better work-life balance. Iâm not really looking for a job. The recruiters got in touch and I thought Iâd discuss. Iâm looking for more challenging work. All of the above are valid answers. I think thereâs another perfectly valid answer that candidates seldom mention probably due to the gravity of the interview room situation. Iâve interviewed over a hundred candidates across different companies and am yet to find anyone that mentions: I am not happy with my current salary and benefits compared to my skills Back to topic of answers. So, when someone answers that they are not learning new things on the job, obviously, youâd be curios to know why and how they have tried to change things. Unfortunately, most candidates simply mention that they are doing repeat work and thereâs not much to learn doing the same thing over and over again. This is where I start feeling a little uneasy. However, I understand that itâs a true statement. If youâre in a similar situation, hereâs some suggestion: read books, and write code based on what youâve read. Then, you can tell a much convincing story that, Iâve forced myself to learn new things and hereâs some proof, but I really want to apply the newly learned skills outside the scope of the âhello worldâ skills. About work-life balance, I totally hear you. And if your current job doesnât suit what you need out of your life, itâs a perfectly valid reason to look for new opportunities. However, make sure youâre able to clearly set the expectation with your potential employer about what work-life balance means for you. For example, if you canât work over 40 hours a week, or must work from home one-two days a week, itâs best to discuss this even before an interview starts to ensure youâre a good match with the employer. If you showed up at in interview just because a recruiter got in touch, Iâd say introspect first. Itâs possible that on our subconcious mind you have expectations that the potential of the new job offers you something that you donât get at the current job. So, instead of a passive asnwer that the you simply acted based on the recruiterâs invite, itâs much convincing to see if you can lay down one or two things that you expect from the new job that you donât get at the current job. About looking for more challenge, it sounds like a cliche unless you can share examples of work that is of challenging to you. May be you like the challenge of using more complicated algorithms, may be you like dealing with a lot of data, may be you like supporting production emergencies, but thereâs gotta be something that you can explicitly mention as challenging. It helps employers to understand if theyâre able to provide you with enough challenge on the job. Finally, if youâre looking for a new job because the current job isnât paying upto the level of your skills and contributions, make sure to communicate it clearly as well. With salaries and benefits, I find it much easier to work with people that know the actual $ figure thatâll make them happy instead of beating around the bush to create confusions all around. Just be confident and tell what makes you happy. If the employer can afford it, most likely theyâll want to get you onboard as a happy employee. If they canât afford it, theyâll do their best. The key here is to be explicit about what you want and be sure and confident about it. In a nutshell, when you walk into an interview itâs yours to lose. The potential employer is investing their time and resources and would rather have you hired than having to interview other candidates. A

jobs.title: Project Manager or Project Officer Biomass Value Chains (f/m/d)
jobs.description: Agora Industry Are you passionate about biomass feedstocks as a means to decarbonise heavy industry applications? Do you bring expertise in the technical, economic and climate policy aspects of biomass availability, processing and use? Are you excited to work in a diverse, multi-disciplinary and international team? Then, this is the perfect opportunity for you! Reaching a climate-neutral industry will require unprecedented investments in a wide range of GHG mitigation technologies, due to the sector’s inherent complexity and regional diversity. While a significant share of emissions can be reduced by advancing energy efficiency and expanding direct electrification powered by renewable energy, there is also the need for more complex and costly measures as well as alternative feedstocks for processes, where biomass and hydrogen technologies can be implemented. To tap into this potential, climate-effective biomass uses in industry require thorough understanding of availability and costs across different regions to give recommendations on policies that help to decarbonise industry in a competitive way, incorporating ecological sustainability boundaries. Under the umbrella of the Agora Think Tanks, Agora Industry develops politically feasible and science-based strategies and solutions for the transformation to climate neutrality – in Germany, Europe, and internationally. As a think tank and policy lab we facilitate a productive exchange of ideas amongst stakeholders from politics, business, science and civil society. As a non-partisan, non-profit organisation funded by foundations and public institutions, we are independent of corporate and partisan interests. Our exclusive mission is to serve the climate and the common good.To strengthen our team, we are looking for a Project Manager or Project Officer Biomass Value Chains (f/m/d) Full- or part-time (min. 32 hours)– based in Berlin You will work on the supply side of biomass as a feedstock for hard-to-electrify applications in industry. The geographical scope will be global, covering different conditions and contexts that vary across geographies. This position is part of Agora Industry’s central Technologies & Analysis team, working closely with regional teams. Your responsibilities include Contributing to the development and implementation of international projects focused on climate-effective biomass solutions for industrial decarbonisation, encompassing farm- and forest-level availability, logistics and conversion technologies, as well as biomass supply for industrial carbon dioxide removal (CDR). Analysing biomass supply costs, availability and potentials for different agriculture and forestry products across multiple geographies, taking into account competing uses in different sectors and market implications. Conducting and coordinating projects on biomass for industrial applications and related technological enablers and policy support mechanisms Analysing policy and regulatory gaps that hinder biomass use in various regions with a focus on economic, regulatory, and governance frameworks. Monitoring the development of technology and business models related to the scaling, mobilization and system integration of biomass value chains and logistics. jobs.description: Your Mission EV charging is evolving from a niche technology into everyday infrastructure. As reev grows, teams increasingly need reliable, consistently defined metrics. Today, different dashboards, reporting dates, filters, and assumptions can produce different answers to the same business question. This role addresses the problem - not by building more dashboards, but by creating a shared and trustworthy data foundation. The goal is to establish clear definitions and consistent metrics so that teams and leadership can make informed decisions based on the same numbers. Someone who understands that unclear definitions, rather than a lack of data, are often the real problem can make a significant impact in this role. You own the certified layer, the single, agreed upon version of every core metric that reev runs on. You connect the definition, the data model, and the delivery. And when two numbers disagree, you are the person who says which one to trust. What you will do Define core metrics with Finance, Product, Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Engineering, and Platform. Agree on definitions , data contracts, and ownership forcore metrics with the teams that own them. Maintain and verify the certified data layer , built in ETL tooland surfaced in Metabase, so teams can build their own dashboards on top of it. Use SQL to validate data , investigate inconsistencies, and trace numbers back to their sources. Work with Platform team to identify potential improvements in data flows, pipelines, and transformations, advise on next steps, and help prioritize next steps during planning. Help stakeholders decide which number to trust when reports disagree. Improve data literacy through practical guidance, workshops, and clear documentation. Use AI-assisted tools for analysis, documentation, automation, and workflows. Check the results carefully. What this role is not You will not be the central owner of every dashboard request. Teams remain responsible for their own dashboards, analyses, and data models built on their data contracts. This is also not a classic infrastructure or people-management role. Confidence working with senior stakeholders and challenging unclear or incorrect numbers. A hands-on , business-minded approach . You connect business questions with practical data solutions. Experience with automation , AI Agents , or AI-supported workflows . Fluent written and spoken English, German is a plus. Our mission is to understand the forces driving us apart, help societies find common ground and bring people together to tackle shared challenges. In the UK, our work is best described as being part consultancy and part think tank. We provide a full suite of research services including polling and focus group research; evidence reviews and secondary data analysis; audience mapping and audience strategy; strategic communications strategy and campaign development. Through our consultancy, More in Common has also supported dozens of partners with insights and strategic communications support. jobs.title: Strategic Client Manager
jobs.description: About Flock Road accidents kill and injure people, damage vehicles, and cost businesses fortunes. But traditional insurance does nothing to prevent them - it just pays out claims when they happen. At Flock, we’re changing that. Using telematics, AI, and real-time data, we proactively help our fleet customers prevent crashes. We obsessively focus on keeping drivers safe, and we put our money where our mouth is - paying out millions of pounds per year to fleets that get safer over time. We were acquired by Admiral in May 2026. Now we combine the backing of the UK’s leading motor insurer with startup energy and speed. We’re growing fast with bigger plans than ever, and we’re hugely optimistic that our approach will save many more lives in the decade ahead. We’re on a mission to make the world quantifiably safer. Join us! About the role Our largest fleet clients are hugely important to Flock: they have more vehicles, more data and more opportunity to benefit from everything our connected proposition can offer, and we want to give them an even better experience as we grow. We’re looking for a Strategic Client Manager to become the primary face of Flock for our largest customers, owning the relationship and making sure they get the very best from us. Nearly all of our business comes through brokers, and that remains central to how we work: you’ll sit at the heart of the client, broker and Flock relationship, working closely with our Broker Development Managers and teams across the business to deliver a brilliant joined-up service. You’ll report to our Head of Distribution, and use AI day to day to prepare for meetings, understand accounts, manage client queries and improve reporting, freeing up more time for relationships and problem-solving. You’ll have the opportunity to build our corporate client management approach from the ground up: shaping account reviews and performance reporting, bringing together claims, safety, underwriting and finance for our biggest clients, and taking real ownership when something needs to get done. Success is simple: our clients stay with us, get more value from Flock and recommend us to others. What you’ll be doing Own the relationship with a portfolio of Flock’s largest fleet clients, becoming their primary point of contact and developing a strong understanding of their business. Build and run our corporate account management approach: client reviews, reporting, relationship cadence and account planning. Work closely with brokers and our Broker Development Managers to deliver a coordinated experience for every client. Bring together teams across Flock, including claims, safety, underwriting and finance, to resolve client questions and issues quickly, and build strong relationships with key stakeholders across client organisations. Identify retention risks early and create clear plans to protect our most important accounts. Support the commercial management of the smaller number of corporate clients that work with Flock directly. Help shape and improve Flock’s wider client service proposition, including account reviews, portal engagement, safety support, claims and reporting, feeding client feedback back into the business. Use AI in your day-to-day work, from account research and meeting preparation to query management, meeting summaries and client reporting. Experience in a client-facing role such as insurer account or deal management, broker account management, claims relationship management or a similar position. jobs.title: Senior Director, Clinical Research - Neurodegeneration
jobs.description: <p><strong>Overview</strong></p> <p>Alnylam Pharmaceuticals is seeking an imaginative physician drug developer. This is an opportunity to provide clinical leadership in developing RNAi therapeutics in Alnylam’s rapidly expanding portfolio, which spans the areas of rare genetic diseases, cardio-metabolic diseases, neuroscience, hematology and hepatology.</p> <p>The successful candidate’s primary role will be to drive the pipeline forward through leadership of clinical development programs.&nbsp; While the primary focus responsibility will be as clinical lead physician on Alnylam’s Huntington’s program, the role may support across a range of therapeutic areas and all stages of development may be required as pipeline assets evolve. The Sr. Director is expected to play a leading and influencing role in the overall clinical development strategies and drive progress and operational excellence for associated clinical trials. In addition, this role will include interaction with Alnylam’s research group, helping to advise the team on the clinical development feasibility of novel targets and the design of proof-of-concept studies. This work will also involve extensive consultation and collaboration with external experts. It is expected that additional opportunities will arise to lead bench-to-bedside early phase clinical development programs.</p> <p>The Senior Director, Clinical Research, will work in a matrix organization across Regulatory, Biostatistics, Clinical Operations, Preclinical, Commercial &amp; QA teams to ensure fully harmonized and integrated development strategies. They will be a key Alnylam Development spokesperson at external meetings, including regulatory interactions and scientific meetings.</p> <p>This position is hybrid and will be primarily located at our Cambridge, MA headquarters or Maidenhead, UK location.</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Be the strategic leader providing a strong, clear voice for the clinical programs</li> <li>Develop creative but realistic approaches to drug development and lead clinical efforts to secure global regulatory approvals</li> <li>Oversight of trial conduct and safety</li> <li>Provide strategic consultation and guidance to Research on all decisions that have significant clinical components and implications.&nbsp;</li> <li>Collaborate closely with Preclinical, Regulatory Affairs, Medical Affairs and Commercial to ensure tight strategic integration of product development plans</li> <li>Be accountable via Clinical Research and Operations for all relevant timelines and deliverables</li> <li>Drive/supervise all major written deliverables&nbsp;(regulatory submissions, original articles, abstracts), and presentation materials</li> <li>Be responsible (as appropriate in line with SOPs) for final review and sign off with respect to all controlled documents including protocols, IBs, informed consent forms</li> <li>Influence internal and external audiences in a high impact, highly visible fashion</li> </ul> <p><strong>Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>MD with strong research background or MD PhD, with a track record of successful research support and peer review publications. Board Certification (or equivalent) or specialist training is highly desirable; drug development experience in neurology (Huntington’s Disease) would be a great advantage, but not essential</li> <li>10+ years industry experience or equivalent clinical academic experience</li> <li>Sound scientific and clinical judgment</li> <li>Successful track record of leading Phase 2/3 clinical programs (preferably in Huntington’s drug development), including major interactions with Health Authorities</li>

jobs.title: Associate Director, Clinical Pharmacology
jobs.description: <p>The Associate Director in Clinical Pharmacology position will support a rapidly expanding clinical portfolio of promising RNAi therapeutics in CNS. The candidate in this position should be well versed in clinical pharmacology, PK and PD with strong ability to critically evaluate and interpret data and conduct data analysis. In this role, the candidate is expected to have a strong critical thinking ability with good oral and written communication skills as well as worked independently in a highly matrixed environment.</p> jobs.title: AI scientist for Quantum Computing (Massy)
jobs.description: About Quandela: Quandela is a European deeptech company building modular, scalable and energy-efficient spin-photonic quantum computers. We develop the full quantum computing stack, from semiconductor quantum emitters and photonic processors to control systems, software and applications. Our platforms are available through the cloud and as on-premises systems. Our ambition is to build fault-tolerant quantum computers capable of solving problems beyond the reach of classical computation. The role: We are looking for an AI Scientist to join Quandela’s AI and Quantum Machine Learning team in Massy (near Paris) You will develop and evaluate machine-learning approaches for quantum computing, covering both: AI for quantum systems , including calibration, control, decoding for quantum error correction; quantum and hybrid machine learning , including rigorous comparisons with state-of-the-art classical methods, using MerLin, Quandela's framework for quantum machine learning. You will work on research with colleagues across AI, quantum algorithms, software, product and hardware. The Massy team is a central part of Quandela’s AI activities. This role therefore offers significant ownership and the opportunity to help shape and grow the team over time. What You'll Do: Design, implement and train machine-learning and quantum machine-learning models. Develop AI methods to improve the calibration, control and performance of quantum systems. Benchmark classical, quantum and hybrid methods using meaningful baselines and evaluation metrics. Contribute actively to the development of the MerLin framework. Contribute to publications and collaborations with academic partners, including research ecosystem. Present your work internally and at scientific conferences and technical events. Help define Quandela’s future AI research directions and mentor junior researchers as the team grows. Requirements What we are looking for: We are looking for an AI scientist, or an experienced industry practitioner with an equivalent background, who is eager to apply state-of-the-art classical machine-learning methods to scientific and engineering challenges in quantum computing. The role is primarily focused on using AI to improve quantum technologies, while also providing opportunities to develop and investigate quantum and hybrid machine-learning models. PhD + 3 years of experience or equivalent industrial R&D experience in machine learning. Strong foundations in modern machine learning, experimental methodology and model evaluation. Excellent scientific programming skills, particularly in Python and common machine-learning frameworks. Experience taking research ideas from initial exploration to robust implementation. Interest in working on both longer term research and concrete product problems. Strong communication skills and the ability to work autonomously within a focused, multidisciplinary team. Professional fluency in English. Bonus Points Previous experience applying AI to physical systems, scientific computing, hardware control or experimental data. Knowledge of quantum computing, quantum machine learning or photonic quantum technologies. Experience mentoring junior researchers or helping define technical research directions. Benefits Competitive salary, flexible based on your experience and expectations Profit-sharing & company savings plan 100% health coverage (Alan) 50% transport reimbursement or sustainable mobility bonus Meal vouchers (Swile), Gymlib fitness support Childcare assistance & referral bonuses (€1,000–€2,000) Process:  Talent Acquisition Interview (30' - 45')  Hiring Manager Interview (45' - 60')  Reference checks  Technical discussion and presentation of previous research work  Meeting with the team Offer  Beyond That: At Quandela, we value scientific curiosity, experimentation and collaboration. jobs.title: Senior Tax Manager (Konzernsteuerreferent*in) (m/w/d)
jobs.description: JOIN OUR TEAM Als Senior Tax Manager unterstützt du unser Finance-Team bei der Betreuung aller steuerlichen Themen der Westwing Group. Du verantwortest dabei die Erstellung des Konzernsteuer-Reportings nach HGB und IFRS, betreust die Ertragsteuererklärungen der deutschen Konzerngesellschaften und treibst spannende Tax-Operations- sowie Digitalisierungsprojekte aktiv voran. Diese Position ist unbefristet , der Arbeitsort ist München. WHAT YOU'LL DO Eigenständige Berechnung der laufenden und latenten Steuern für den Konzernabschluss nach HGB und IFRS (IAS 12) einschließlich ETR-Überleitung sowie Erstellung aller relevanten Anhangsangaben (Tax Notes) im Rahmen des Fast-Close-Prozesses Fachliche Erstellung der laufenden Ertragsteuererklärungen der deutschen Konzerngesellschaften Fachliche Kommunikation mit Finanzbehörden sowie aktive Betreuung steuerlicher Betriebsprüfungen Mitarbeit und Übernahme von Aufgaben bei Steuerprojekten, z.B. Einarbeitung in Spezialthemen des Ertragsteuerrechts, Mitwirkung beim Tax CMS sowie Optimierung von Schnittstellen in Steuer-Workflows Enger Austausch mit internen Fachbereichen des Konzerns (Accounting, Controlling, Legal, FinTech) sowie Koordination externer steuerlicher Berater im In- und Ausland YOU COME WITH Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium der Wirtschaftswissenschaften, der Rechtswissenschaften mit Schwerpunkt Steuerrecht oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation (ein abgelegtes Steuerberaterexamen ist ein Plus, aber keine Voraussetzung) Mindestens fünf Jahre praktische Berufserfahrung innerhalb einer Konzernsteuerabteilung oder eine vergleichbare Tätigkeit in einer Big Four- oder mittelständischen Steuerberatungsgesellschaft Fundierte und praxiserprobte Kenntnisse im deutschen Ertragsteuerrecht (Organschaften, Verlustnutzung) sowie in der steuerlichen Rechnungslegung nach HGB und IFRS (insb. IAS 12) Freude an steuerlicher Projektarbeit, Affinität zu digitalen Steuerprozessen und die Bereitschaft, dich tief in neue Ertragsteuerthemen einzuarbeiten Lösungsorientierte, strukturierte und selbstständige Arbeitsweise im dynamischen Umfeld mit dem Anspruch, Themen eigenständig voranzutreiben Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse sowie versierter Umgang mit gängigen ERP-Systemen (z.B. jobs.description: JOIN OUR TEAM As a Senior MS Dynamics Business Central Developer , you will join our global Tech team and play a pivotal role in shaping the technical backbone of our operations. In this senior role, you will take full ownership of core development initiatives, optimize complex system architectures, and partner closely with cross-functional teams to engineer innovative, scalable solutions. jobs.description: We’re Heidi. We're building the future of healthcare by giving every clinician the earth's finest AI Care Partner. Our mission is simple: double the world’s healthcare capacity and strengthen the human connection at its heart. We found product-market fit with a freemium medical scribe that clinicians love. At Heidi, the CSM owns the customer from day one: the relationship, the rollout plan, the path to renewal. The Implementation Engineer is the technical arm they lean on: the person who personally configures SSO with the customer's IT team, sets up and provisions tenants, delivers EHR integrations through to go-live, configures agents and custom builds, and gives every technical problem a fast diagnosis and the right owner — fixing what is configuration, and handing confirmed product defects to Support Engineering, who own and drive their resolution. It ends when the agreed technical scope has passed its acceptance criteria, customer sign-off has been recorded, the final configuration has been documented and the implementation has transferred into hypercare or BAU support. You are technically credible in front of a CIO, precise in what you hand to engineers, and relentless about closing the loop — and you translate what customers need technically into clear, prioritised asks for the Technical Program Manager (TPM), who owns the integration roadmap and prioritisation. Success in this role looks like: Hands-on delivery — you personally set up, configure and validate the technical footprint of an account: identity, provisioning, integrations, agents, data flows. Not coordinated — done. Technical ownership — every technical problem at your accounts gets a fast diagnosis and a clear owner. What is configuration or implementation, you fix; what is a product defect, Support Engineering owns and drives — you hand it over with the diagnosis attached and do not shadow the ticket. CSMs never have to diagnose or route technical problems themselves. Fast unblocking — technical blockers that would stall a launch for weeks get diagnosed, sequenced and resolved in days, because you understand the problem and know exactly who has to do what. Clean boundaries — you hand net-new build work to FDEs as precise, prioritised requirements they can act on without rework, and you route live product defects to Support Engineering with a proper diagnosis attached — you don’t hoard work that belongs elsewhere, and you don’t toss problems over walls. jobs.title: Technical Support Engineer (L2) - Compute
jobs.description: About Mistral Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms. We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited. Mistral AI is building a new Compute Support team to ensure the reliability, performance, and scalability of our GPU clusters in a Kubernetes environment. As one of the founding members of this team, you will play a pivotal role in shaping its processes, standards, and culture. In this hybrid L1/L2 support role, you will be the first point of contact for customers and internal teams, providing technical guidance, troubleshooting, and issue resolution for compute-related inquiries. You’ll also serve as the escalation point for complex issues, leveraging your deep systems knowledge, Kubernetes expertise, and operational debugging skills to ensure our AI workloads run smoothly at scale. This is a support-focused role that blends system administration, customer-facing communication, and compute infrastructure expertise. While coding is not the primary focus, familiarity with Go for debugging and automation is a plus. Key Responsibilities First Customer’s Point of Contact Act as the first interlocutor for customers and internal teams, providing timely and effective responses to compute-related inquiries. Triage and prioritize incoming requests, ensuring SLAs are met for acknowledgment, first response, and resolution. Gather and analyze initial issue details (e.g., logs, error messages, system metrics) to diagnose problems efficiently. Provide clear, actionable guidance to customers and internal users, including temporary workarounds where applicable. Technical Support Serve as the L2 escalation point for Linux, Kubernetes, and compute infrastructure issues, providing deep technical troubleshooting for: GPU/TPU workloads (e.g., CUDA errors, memory leaks, job failures). Kubernetes clusters (e.g., pod crashes, node failures, networking misconfigurations). Bare metal and cloud environments (e.g., AWS EC2, GCP VMs, HPC clusters). Diagnose and resolve performance bottlenecks, hardware failures, and resource contention in distributed systems. Analyze system metrics, logs, and traces (e.g., dmesg, journalctl, nvidia-smi, Prometheus, Grafana) to identify root causes of issues. Participate in on-call rotations to provide 24/7 support for critical compute systems Nice to have: Optimize system configurations (e.g., kernel parameters, filesystem tuning, network settings) for high-performance computing (HPC) and AI workloads. Kubernetes & Containerization Debug Kubernetes clusters with a focus on: Pod and node issues (e.g., CrashLoopBackOff, OOMKilled, ImagePullBackOff). Networking and storage (e.g., CNI plugins, PersistentVolumes, StorageClasses). Resource management (e.g., Requests/Limits, QOS classes, node affinity). Troubleshoot container runtime issues (Docker, containerd) such as image pull failures, OCI compliance, or runtime errors. Collaborate with SRE teams to understand and improve existing IaC (Terraform, Ansible) and Go-based tooling. Documentation & Process Improvement Create and maintain runbooks, playbooks, and internal documentation for common compute issues (e.g., GPU debugging, Kubernetes troubleshooting). Contribute to post-mortems with actionable follow-ups to prevent recurring incidents. Train internal teams on best practices for compute infrastructure and debugging. Help define and refine support processes as a founding member of the new Compute Support

jobs.title: Head of Design Operations
jobs.description: Our client is an established architecture and design firm specialising in large-scale workplace projects across France and wider Europe. As the business enters its next phase of growth, they are seeking a Head of Design Operations to take operational ownership of the design function which includes leading a team of designers and technical staff, managing budgets and workload, and ensuring every concept and technical output meets the standard their international clients expect. Key Responsibilities Provide hands-on operational leadership to design professionals and external freelance resources, across concept development and technical design phases. Manage workload allocation, resourcing and scheduling so the team delivers reliably and to deadline. Own budget oversight and cost control across the design function. Review, challenge and quality-check technical plans and design outputs before they go to clients, ensuring they meet required technical, accessibility and regulatory standards. Act as a key client-facing point of contact on design quality and delivery for international clients on large-scale workplace projects. Strategically deploy freelance and external resources for technical or lower-value tasks to support the team's ability to scale. Coach, mentor and develop a team of creative and technical professionals, building a stable, high-performing team culture. Partner closely with the pre-construction and delivery teams to ensure a seamless handover of projects from concept through to completion. Report to senior leadership on team performance, project status and resourcing needs.   Requirements Significant experience in an operational leadership role within architecture, interior design, workplace fit-out or construction, gained in a design, delivery or technical management capacity. Proven track record managing and developing teams of design or technical professionals, including workload planning and resourcing. Demonstrated experience overseeing project budgets and cost control. Strong technical literacy, with the ability to read, review and challenge technical and design plans, even without personally producing creative concepts. Client-facing experience, with the ability to build trust with international clients. Professional working proficiency in French. Eligibility to work in France, or to obtain the relevant right to work. Preferred Qualifications Background as an architect, interior designer, or in a related technical/design discipline. Candidates from construction or similar technical backgrounds are also encouraged to apply; a design qualification is not essential. Working knowledge of Revit. Fluency in English is valuable given the team's exposure to international projects across Europe. Experience developing creative concepts and pitching to clients (an advantage, not a requirement). Experience in workplace design, fit-out, or large-scale commercial interior projects. Benefits Base salary: €75,000 to €90,000 gross per annum, commensurate with experience, with flexibility for an exceptional candidate. Variable incentive: To be confirmed and discussed with shortlisted candidates. Working pattern: Hybrid, 2 days of remote work per week. Travel: Approximately 5% of time, across European project sites. Leave: French statutory annual leave entitlement (minimum 25 working days). Any additional leave or benefits to be confirmed with shortlisted candidates. Keller is a recruitment agency that provides services to clients ranging from startups and non profits to multinational corporations. Keller emphasizes ethical search processes, attentive candidate care, and leadership placements that support long-term client outcomes. Denn unsere digitalen Lösungen sind für Menschen gemacht und haben gesellschaftliche Relevanz. Klingt spannend? Deine Mission bei ]init[ Du möchtest digitale Projekte nicht nur verwalten, sondern aktiv gestalten und gemeinsam mit deinen Kund:innen weiterentwickeln? Als Senior Project Manager (all genders) übernimmst du Verantwortung für anspruchsvolle digitale Kommunikationsprojekte – mit einem besonderen Schwerpunkt auf CMS-basierten Informationsangeboten und Websites sowie deren Weiterentwicklung und Betrieb. Dabei bewegst du dich an der Schnittstelle von Technologie, digitaler Kommunikationsberatung, Kreation und Content. Dabei verbindest du eine sichere Steuerung digitaler Umsetzungsprojekte mit einem guten Gespür für die Bedarfe deiner Kund:innen. Du erkennst Entwicklungspotenziale, bringst die richtigen Expert:innen zusammen und sorgst dafür, dass aus Ideen erfolgreiche digitale Lösungen in der Umsetzung werden. Das gibt es zu tun Du steuerst anspruchsvolle digitale Umsetzungsprojekte und hältst Scope, Budget, Qualität und Timing sicher auf Kurs. Dein Schwerpunkt liegt auf digitalen Kommunikationsprojekten – insbesondere CMS-basierten Informationsangeboten und Websites sowie deren Weiterentwicklung und Betrieb. Dabei arbeitest du mit Teams aus Technologie, digitaler Kommunikationsberatung, Kreation, Content und UX zusammen. Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Kund:innen und interdisziplinären Projektteams zusammen, verstehst Anforderungen und Herausforderungen und übersetzt sie in konkrete Projektziele und Lösungen. Für dich endet Projektmanagement nicht mit der erfolgreichen Delivery: Du erkennst neue Bedarfe und Potenziale bei bestehenden Kund:innen und entwickelst Projekte und Kundenbeziehungen gemeinsam mit unseren Fachexpert:innen weiter. Du bringst deine Erfahrung und Projektperspektive in Angebote, Ausschreibungen und Pitches ein. Wenn du hier bereits Erfahrung mitbringst, umso besser – wenn nicht, kannst du dich bei uns gezielt in diesem Bereich weiterentwickeln. Du steuerst unterschiedliche Stakeholder souverän und sorgst auch in komplexen Projektsituationen für Klarheit, Verbindlichkeit und eine gute Zusammenarbeit. Das bringst du mit Du hast mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Steuerung digitaler Umsetzungsprojekte – idealerweise rund um Websites, Informationsplattformen oder andere CMS-basierte Lösungen. Du verstehst Projektmanagement nicht als reine Verwaltung, sondern möchtest Projekte, Lösungen und Kundenbeziehungen aktiv mitgestalten und weiterentwickeln. Du hast Freude daran, Kund:innen und ihre Herausforderungen zu verstehen, Potenziale zu erkennen und gemeinsam mit interdisziplinären Teams passende Lösungen zu entwickeln. Du bist sowohl in der Zusammenarbeit mit technischen Teams als auch mit Disziplinen wie Kommunikation, UX, Design, Kreation oder Content sicher unterwegs. Erfahrung in Presales, Business Development, Ausschreibungen oder Angebotserstellung ist ein Plus – aber kein Muss. Ob agil oder klassisch: Du kennst unterschiedliche Projektmethoden und setzt sie passend zur jeweiligen Situation ein. Eine Zertifizierung ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss. jobs.description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><span data-sheets-root="1">About Wolt</span></h2> <p><span data-sheets-root="1">At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.<br><br>Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.</span></p></div><p>Wolt is a Finnish technology company on a mission to make cities better places to live by empowering local commerce. Since 2014, we've grown from food delivery in Helsinki into a platform spanning groceries, retail, and more, operating in 30+ countries and 800+ cities together with DoorDash. Wolt Market is our own grocery concept, bringing everyday essentials to customers' doors in minutes, and our Wolt Market business in Germany is growing fast. We're looking for a Supply Chain Analyst to help keep our stores stocked, our operations efficient, and our customers happy.</p> <h2>What you’ll be doing</h2> <p>As a Supply Chain Analyst, you'll be the person who keeps our Wolt Market stores in Germany running smoothly behind the scenes, making sure the right products are on the shelf at the right time. The role calls for deep experience in algorithm and assay development, NGS data processing across multiple modalities, and the full life cycle of diagnostic product research and development in a regulated (CLIA) setting. You will evaluate new technologies and NGS assays, implement methods to optimize performance, and help define the product profile from a bioinformatics perspective, with input from R&D, Product, and Laboratory Directors. Primary Responsibilities: Team Leadership and Development: Lead and mentor a team of Bioinformatics Scientists. Own their professional growth, their responsibilities, and the standard the team holds itself to. Research Strategy: Own the research strategy behind new product development, from scoping through execution, working with cross-functional stakeholders on what the team takes on and in what order. Assay Science: Lead bioinformatics analysis for assay development and optimization, and troubleshoot experiments alongside laboratory scientists. This spans multi-omic approaches including methylation and fragmentomics and other cell-free DNA (cfDNA) derived features. It also spans short-read and long-read sequencing and both hybrid-capture and amplicon target enrichment. Study Design and Data Quality: Partner with laboratory teams on study design at the research and feasibility stage, covering new technology assessment, optimization, and performance determination. Make sure the resulting data holds up before anyone builds on it. Analysis Method Improvement: Advise and prototype improvements to analysis pipelines, including variant detection, quality control, and modality-specific processing: methylation calling, fragment-size and end-motif analysis, error suppression for deep targeted panels, and structural-variant calling. Production Readiness and Handoff: Move research prototypes into stable production workflows. Hold the team to software engineering practice, including version control, testing, continuous integration and delivery, and containerization. Automate the routine parts of research data management, pipeline execution, and reporting so the team's time goes to science. Ways of Working: AI is a routine part of the work here. As the leader of this team you set what correct use looks like: what an agent may conclude on its own, and what requires a scientist to sign off. We do not screen for prior experience with these tools, and many strong candidates come from environments where they were restricted; we provide the tooling and the ramp time. Cross-functional Partnership: Work with data science, molecular biology, pipeline engineering, biostatistics, quality assurance, and laboratory operations on new products and on the transition of research work into production. Act as the subject-matter expert those groups come to, and explain findings and the roadmap clearly at every level of the company. What success looks like after a year: The team has a research roadmap you own, and progress against it is visible outside the team. You independently advise and guide research strategies in cross functional settings. New analysis methods from your team are implemented within production code and demonstrate expected performance on benchmark studies.. You and team members become trusted experts that other functions direct their hard questions to, and can independently support decision making. AI agent-assisted work is normal on the team, with a standard for it that you set. Qualifications: Ph.D. in Bioinform

jobs.title: AWS Data Engineer (Senior)
jobs.description: Mactores is the agent-native AWS modernization firm. Most modernization work doesn't ship, it stalls in pilots, slips a year, or lands at three times the budget. We exist to ship it: production systems running, legacy retired, outcomes measured. Our delivery is built on Aedeon, the agent platform built by Mactores' founders' sister company, which absorbs the repetitive 60–70% of engagement work, discovery, dependency mapping, validation, test generation, that traditional consulting bills human hours against. Forward-deployed engineers own the rest: architecture, judgment, and cutover, on dates we commit to in the contract. This is a senior role in our Data Platform Modernization pillar: consolidating and migrating customer data infrastructure on AWS in weeks, not quarters, at meaningfully lower engagement cost than traditional data consulting. Customers come to us after a data program has stalled pipelines nobody trusts, warehouses nobody runs new workloads on, a modernization that produced diagrams instead of production systems. Aedeon handles automated source discovery, schema mapping, lineage extraction, and parallel-run validation. You own what agents can't: target architecture, data model decisions, pipeline design under real constraints, and the calls that make a cutover safe. You'll build with PySpark and SQL on EMR and Glue, model for Redshift, Snowflake, Athena, and Presto, orchestrate with Airflow and your work will reach production, not a slide deck. What you will do? Build and maintain data pipelines on Amazon EMR or Amazon Glue that run in production. Design data models and end-user querying on Amazon Redshift or Snowflake, Amazon Athena, and Presto. Build and maintain pipeline orchestration with Airflow. Work with customer and internal teams to understand data needs and design the solutions that meet them. Troubleshoot and optimize pipelines and data models until they hold up under real load. Write and maintain PySpark and SQL scripts to extract, transform, and load data. Document and communicate technical decisions to technical and non-technical audiences — customers sign off on what we ship. Track new AWS data technologies and judge their impact on the systems we run. What are we looking for? Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. 3+ years of experience working with PySpark and SQL. 2+ years of experience building and maintaining data pipelines using Amazon EMR or Amazon Glue. 2+ years of experience with data modeling and end-user querying using Amazon Redshift or Snowflake, Amazon Athena, and Presto. 1+ years of experience building and maintaining pipeline orchestration using Airflow. Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting skills. Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Ability to work independently and within a team environment. You are preferred if you have AWS Data Analytics Specialty Certification Experience with Agile development methodology How we work? We run a forward-deployed model. Senior engineers embed with the customer's team, own outcomes from discovery through production, and carry the delivery commitment personally fixed dates, with Mactores absorbing overage cost for delays inside our control. Aedeon absorbs scale; you absorb judgment. That means less of your week goes to inventory spreadsheets and manual validation, and more goes to architecture, data modeling, and cutover strategy. The culture is casual and steers clear of rigid corporate habits. We measure ourselves by what ships. Compensation Additional Information Life at Mactores We care about creating a culture that makes a real difference in the lives of every Mactorian. Our 10 Core Leadership Principles that honor Decision-making, Leadership, Collaboration, and Curiosity drive how we work. 1. Be one step ahead 2. Deliver the best 3. Be bold 4. Pay attention to the detail 5. Enjoy the challenge 6. Be curious and take action 7. Take leadership 8. Own it 9. Deliver value 10. Be collaborative

We think that's because the problem needed AI, not just better software, before it was solvable. Frontline organisations sit on enormous amounts of operational data. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe , Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce . We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold. The role is part of our Business Analytics Center of Excellence, where Analysts are assigned to support one or more business functions. This role will specifically work with our Marketing organization—spanning paid search (SEM), organic search (SEO), and emerging Generative AI channels—from structuring the underlying data infrastructure to developing reports that support marketing leaders in making data-driven decisions. jobs.title: Senior Data Analyst, GTM Analytics - CANADA
jobs.description: Luxury Presence is building the AI growth platform for real estate. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and other top investors, we're a Series C company that has hit $100M in annual recurring revenue. More than 90,000 real estate professionals, including over 30% of the WSJ Real Trends top 100 agents in the United States, use us to run and grow their business. Why This Role Matters Our GTM Analytics team owns the metrics that run the business for Sales, Marketing, and Client Success. We're past the phase of standing up basic reporting — we're now building a modern, agentic analytics practice, including Lighthouse, our internal BI-as-code platform, where dashboards, metrics, and semantic definitions live in version-controlled code rather than scattered across disconnected tools. This role is a chance to shape that next chapter. You'll partner directly with Sales, Marketing, and CS leaders to answer their hardest questions about pipeline, funnel conversion, campaign performance, and retention, while helping build the infrastructure and AI-forward workflows that let the whole GTM org get trustworthy answers faster. You'll report to our Senior Manager of Analytics and work in tight, two-week sprints alongside Analytics Engineering, so you'll see your work ship and get used — fast. What You'll Do GTM Analysis & Decision Support Deliver decision-ready analysis across Sales, Marketing, and Client Success: pipeline health, funnel conversion, campaign and channel performance, cohort/retention, and GRR/NRR drivers. Partner directly with Sales, Marketing, and CSM stakeholders to scope questions, frame recommendations, and see analysis through to a decision — not just a dashboard handoff. Bring structure to ambiguous asks — translate a stakeholder's question into a clear, testable analytical approach. Data Modeling & Quality Build and maintain dbt models and marts for Sales, Marketing, and CS domains, with Salesforce as a core source system. Own data quality and documentation for your domain: clear definitions, source-of-truth tables, and QA that stakeholders can trust without double-checking. Lighthouse & Agentic Analytics Contribute to Lighthouse, our BI-as-code platform, as we build it out — help define how dashboards, metrics, and semantic models get written, versioned, and reviewed like software. Note: Lighthouse is an active build, not a finished platform — you'll be shaping it, not just using it. Push our analytics workflows toward agentic AI: using AI agents to accelerate analysis, automate recurring reporting, and cut down on manual, one-off dashboard requests. Bring a point of view on where AI can replace manual analyst work versus where it can't — you should be as comfortable prompting and evaluating an agent as writing the SQL yourself. How You'll Work Operate in two-week sprints, planning and prioritizing your own backlog against team OKRs alongside your manager. Give clear, proactive status updates to stakeholders rather than waiting to be asked. What We're Looking For Experience 5+ years in analytics/BI, with meaningful time supporting Sales, Marketing, or Customer Success functions at a fast-growing company. Staff-level candidates should bring deeper scope — larger or more ambiguous problems owned end-to-end, and a track record of setting technical direction, not just executing against it. Expert SQL and hands-on dbt experience modeling GTM data. Comfortable with Python for analysis and automation — this isn't a heavy ML/stats role, but you know how to script your way out of manual work. Experience with Salesforce as a data source — you understand CRM objects, fields, and the quirks of modeling data. Familiarity with a modern data stack: Fivetran or similar EL tooling, and a cloud warehouse (we run Snowflake; BigQuery experience also welcome). jobs.description: At Serve Robotics, we’re reimagining how things move in cities. Our personable sidewalk robot is our vision for the future. It’s designed to take deliveries away from congested streets, make deliveries available to more people, and benefit local businesses. The Serve fleet has been delighting merchants, customers, and pedestrians along the way in Los Angeles, Miami, Dallas, Atlanta and Chicago while doing commercial deliveries. We’re looking for talented individuals who will grow robotic deliveries from surprising novelty to efficient ubiquity. Who We Are We are tech industry veterans in software, hardware, and design who are pooling our skills to build the future we want to live in. We are solving real-world problems leveraging robotics, machine learning and computer vision, among other disciplines, with a mindful eye towards the end-to-end user experience. Our team is agile, diverse, and driven. We believe that the best way to solve complicated dynamic problems is collaboratively and respectfully. The Data Analyst drives data management workflows and performs data analysis. This role connects our internal systems with various logistics partners, builds data pipelines, calculates metrics, and creates dashboards & alerts to highlight operational bottlenecks. This position leverages AI tools and frameworks to build faster, create scalable API connections, and manage the data architecture that keeps Serve’s supply chain running. JOB DUTIES Develop and manage API-based workflows to ensure seamless communication between our core business platforms and external logistics partners. Design, build, and maintain automated pipelines to retrieve and route data across various internal and external databases and tools. Perform hands-on data analysis (e.g., tracking average shipping times, inventory flows, etc.) and build automated spreadsheets and/or dashboards for stakeholders. Implement error handling, alerting, etc. to ensure data workflows run consistently and accurately. Partner with Supply Chain, Operations, Finance, and Engineering stakeholders to define KPIs, reporting requirements, and data quality standards across supply chain processes. Conduct root cause analysis on operational issues and recommend process improvements that reduce cost, improve inventory accuracy, and increase logistics performance. Create and maintain technical documentation for data models, integrations, workflows, and reporting systems to support long term scalability and knowledge sharing. EXPERIENCE, QUALIFICATIONS, & SKILLS Required Experience, Qualifications, and Skills 5 years of hands-on experience in data analysis, data engineering, workflow automation, or similar technical roles. Strong general knowledge of data structures and data management, both for big data using cloud databases and small data using excel & google sheets. Advanced knowledge of SQL and at least one other programming language (ideally Python or Javascript). Proficiency in modern AI-driven development including AI coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Codex), Model Context Protocol (MCP), configuration of Skills, sub-agents, etc. and familiarity with popular AI orchestration frameworks such as Langgraph, OpenAI API/SDK, Gemini API/SDK, etc. Experience designing data models and transforming data from multiple operational systems into clean, reliable datasets for reporting and analysis. Strong analytical and problem solving skills, with the ability to translate complex data into actionable business recommendations for nontechnical stakeholders. Demonstrated ability to independently manage multiple projects, prioritize competing requests, and deliver high quality work in a fast paced environment. jobs.title: Research Staff, Voice AI Foundations
jobs.description: Company Overview Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram. Company Operating Rhythm At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance. Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do. Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5. The Opportunity Voice is the most natural modality for human interaction with machines. However, current sequence modeling paradigms based on jointly scaling model and data cannot deliver voice AI capable of universal human interaction. The challenges are rooted in fundamental data problems posed by audio: real-world audio data is scarce and enormously diverse, spanning a vast space of voices, speaking styles, and acoustic conditions. Even if billions of hours of audio were accessible, its inherent high dimensionality creates computational and storage costs that make training and deployment prohibitively expensive at world scale. We believe that entirely new paradigms for audio AI are needed to overcome these challenges and make voice interaction accessible to everyone. The Role As a Member of the Research Staff, you will pioneer the development of Latent Space Models (LSMs), a new approach that aims to solve the fundamental data, scale, and cost challenges associated with building robust, contextualized voice AI. Your research will focus on solving one or more of the following problems: Build next-generation neural audio codecs that achieve extreme, low bit-rate compression and high fidelity reconstruction across a world-scale corpus of general audio. Pioneer steerable generative models that can synthesize the full diversity of human speech from the codec latent representation, from casual conversation to highly emotional expression to complex multi-speaker scenarios with environmental noise and overlapping speech. Develop embedding systems that cleanly factorize the codec latent space into interpretable dimensions of speaker, content, style, environment, and channel effects -- enabling precise control over each aspect and the ability to massively amplify an existing seed dataset through “latent recombination”. Leverage latent recombination to generate synthetic audio data at previously impossible scales, unlocking joint model and data scaling paradigms for audio. Endeavor to train multimodal speech-to-speech systems that can 1) understand any human irrespective of their demographics, state, or environment

Build mechanisms for measuring impact , evaluating model performance, and driving prioritization of new data initiatives. Operate with high ownership in an ambiguous, fast-moving environment helping to define the long-term vision for our financial products. About you You are a Senior Data Scientist who cares deeply about impact and has direct experience with the kind of models that carry real financial consequence. From a skills perspective, you bring: You have 5+ years of data science experience , ideally with a strong background in fintech, credit, lending, or payments. You have deep expertise in fraud and/or underwriting. You know how to build models that balance risk and growth, and you understand the nuances of financial data. You're highly analytical and technical. You are an expert in SQL and Python.

In this role, you will take technical ownership of designing, building, and extending mission-critical SAP applications—leveraging modern development paradigms such as the ABAP RESTful Application Programming Model (RAP) and Core Data Services (CDS). You will drive modern, upgrade-stable SAP development by adhering strictly to "Clean Core" architectural guidelines. Rather than relying on legacy, modification-heavy ABAP patterns, you will build side-by-side extensions on SAP BTP, expose optimized OData services, push heavy calculations down to the in-memory SAP HANA database, and deliver intuitive user experiences via SAP Fiori. What we’re looking for: 5+ years of SAP development experience, with at least 3 years dedicated to S/4HANA, featuring expert command of Object-Oriented ABAP (OO-ABAP), New ABAP Syntax (7.4+), and RAP (ABAP RESTful Application Programming Model). Advanced proficiency authoring complex Core Data Services (CDS) Views, parameters, associations, access controls (DCL), and ABAP Managed Database Procedures (AMDP) for code push-down performance. Extensive experience creating and exposing OData v2/v4 services via SAP Gateway (SEGW) or RAP business services for UI consumption and third-party cloud integrations. Practical experience developing custom SAP Fiori / SAPUI5 applications or configuring Fiori Elements apps using CDS annotations. Firm understanding of modern SAP extensibility frameworks, including On-Stack Developer Extensibility (Embedded ABAP / Steampunk) and Side-by-Side Extensibility using SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP). Proven ability to trace, profile, and optimize ABAP/HANA execution using Runtime Analysis (SAT), ABAP Test Cockpit (ATC), SQL Trace (ST05), and SQL Monitor (SQLM). Nice-to-have skills: Hands-on experience developing side-by-side extensions on SAP BTP using Node.js/CAP (Cloud Application Programming Model) or ABAP Cloud. Background in legacy-to-S/4HANA code remediation, custom code analysis (CCA), and migration projects. Exposure to Event-Driven Architecture using SAP Event Mesh or Kafka integrations. Knowledge of standard SAP S/4HANA business process modules (FI/CO, SD, MM, or PP). Responsibilities: Architect, build, and maintain high-performing transactional and analytical SAP applications using ABAP RAP, CDS views, and AMDP. Build upgrade-stable enhancements and side-by-side extensions, strictly minimizing legacy modifications to protect core system stability. jobs.title: ICT/Telecom
jobs.description: TEECOM hires by discipline, not by open requisition. We are growing — multiple teams across the US, UK, and India are actively hiring to grow their teams. When you apply here, you are applying to TEECOM for a role in ICT/Telecom. Rather than interviewing for a single posted role, you will go through a structured Discipline Assessment that establishes your level and demonstrated capability. Once your level is determined, TEECOM 's recruiting and leadership teams match your profile to the best available opening on a team that fits your skills, experience, and goals. Roles span Designer II through Principal, Senior Consultant. Your level — and your title — are determined by your assessment, not by the role you apply to. If you have meaningful experience in more than one discipline, apply to your primary discipline and tell your recruiter about your secondary discipline(s) during your Introduction Call. You may be scheduled for a separate Discipline Assessment for each one. ICT/Telecom at TEECOM TEECOM 's ICT/Telecom practice designs and documents the telecommunications and structured cabling infrastructure that connects buildings, campuses, and organizations. Our clients span a wide and growing range of industries and facility types across the US, UK, and India. Work spans structured cabling systems (copper and fiber), outside plant infrastructure, distributed antenna systems (DAS), public safety radio coverage, passive optical networks, and other low-voltage communications infrastructure. ICT/Telecom designers at TEECOM work across the full project lifecycle — from concept design and basis of design through construction documents, specifications, and construction administration. You will collaborate with architects, MEP engineers, IT teams, and construction managers to deliver coordinated, buildable technology infrastructure drawings. At more senior levels, you will lead design decisions, mentor junior staff, manage client relationships, and help grow TEECOM 's ICT/Telecom practice. What We're Looking For We hire at all levels — the strongest ICT/Telecom candidates are proactive, curious about how infrastructure actually gets built, and take ownership of producing documents that contractors can follow without guessing. If you don’t have everything on this list yet, that’s expected — TEECOM develops people through structured documentation, mentorship, and real project work. Experience designing structured cabling systems (copper and fiber) across a range of facility types and industries Familiarity with BICSI standards, TIA/EIA cabling standards, and applicable low-voltage code requirements (NFPA 70, local codes) Ability to read and produce construction documents — floor plans, riser diagrams, details, and specification sections Experience with Revit and/or AutoCAD for technology systems documentation Understanding of outside plant infrastructure, including conduit routing, manholes, and fiber optic systems — preferred Experience with DAS design or public safety radio systems (NFPA 72, IFC) — preferred BICSI RCDD (Registered Communications Distribution Designer) certification — preferred PE license (electrical preferred) — preferred Ability to manage your own work independently across multiple concurrent projects * TEECOM covers exam fees and study materials for certifications relevant to your discipline, pays a one-time bonus when you pass, and funds all continuing education — including conference attendance. TEECOM is a fully remote consulting firm. We hire across all US states, the UK, and India. jobs.title: ICT/Telecom
jobs.description: TEECOM hires by discipline, not by open requisition. We are growing — multiple teams across the US, UK, and India are actively hiring to grow their teams. When you apply here, you are applying to TEECOM for a role in ICT/Telecom. Rather than interviewing for a single posted role, you will go through a structured Discipline Assessment that establishes your level and demonstrated capability. Once your level is determined, TEECOM 's recruiting and leadership teams match your profile to the best available opening on a team that fits your skills, experience, and goals. Roles span Designer II through Principal, Senior Consultant. Your level — and your title — are determined by your assessment, not by the role you apply to. If you have meaningful experience in more than one discipline, apply to your primary discipline and tell your recruiter about your secondary discipline(s) during your Introduction Call. You may be scheduled for a separate Discipline Assessment for each one. ICT/Telecom at TEECOM TEECOM 's ICT/Telecom practice designs and documents the telecommunications and structured cabling infrastructure that connects buildings, campuses, and organizations. Our clients span a wide and growing range of industries and facility types across the US, UK, and India. Work spans structured cabling systems (copper and fiber), outside plant infrastructure, distributed antenna systems (DAS), public safety radio coverage, passive optical networks, and other low-voltage communications infrastructure. ICT/Telecom designers at TEECOM work across the full project lifecycle — from concept design and basis of design through construction documents, specifications, and construction administration. You will collaborate with architects, MEP engineers, IT teams, and construction managers to deliver coordinated, buildable technology infrastructure drawings. At more senior levels, you will lead design decisions, mentor junior staff, manage client relationships, and help grow TEECOM 's ICT/Telecom practice. What We're Looking For We hire at all levels — the strongest ICT/Telecom candidates are proactive, curious about how infrastructure actually gets built, and take ownership of producing documents that contractors can follow without guessing. If you don’t have everything on this list yet, that’s expected — TEECOM develops people through structured documentation, mentorship, and real project work. Experience designing structured cabling systems (copper and fiber) across a range of facility types and industries Familiarity with BICSI standards, TIA/EIA cabling standards, and applicable low-voltage code requirements (NFPA 70, local codes) Ability to read and produce construction documents — floor plans, riser diagrams, details, and specification sections Experience with Revit and/or AutoCAD for technology systems documentation Understanding of outside plant infrastructure, including conduit routing, manholes, and fiber optic systems — preferred Experience with DAS design or public safety radio systems (NFPA 72, IFC) — preferred BICSI RCDD (Registered Communications Distribution Designer) certification — preferred PE license (electrical preferred) — preferred Ability to manage your own work independently across multiple concurrent projects * TEECOM covers exam fees and study materials for certifications relevant to your discipline, pays a one-time bonus when you pass, and funds all continuing education — including conference attendance. TEECOM is a fully remote consulting firm. We hire across all US states, the UK, and India. Our projects span the globe — some roles involve international travel, so share your comfort level with your recruiter. If you're ready to be assessed on your own merits and matched to the right team, apply here. If you have questions about the process, contact recruiting directly. Originally posted on Himalayas

jobs.description: Department: Sales Reporting to: UK Pod Lead Employment type: Full-time Salary: £40,000-£45,000; OTE up to £105,000 Location: Remote, UK-based, with monthly London meetups and regular periods working from China of up to 3 weeks at a time Languages: Fluent Mandarin and professional-level English About Gocertify Gocertify is a bootstrapped UK tech start-up helping brands run smarter, more targeted reward campaigns. We verify eligible audiences such as students, key workers and seniors, so brands can move away from broad discounting, protect brand value and offer the right rewards to the right customers. We are trusted by 500+ brands, including Samsung, Sainsbury's and FARFETCH. We work with 2m+ shoppers a year, drive £125m+ in retail sales, and have grown profitably and bootstrapped since 2020. We are a team of around 20 people, working remotely with monthly meetups in London. Why this role exists China is becoming an increasingly important market for Gocertify. We are already seeing strong opportunities with over 50 Chinese consumer brands looking to grow in the UK and other international markets, and now want someone focused on developing that market full-time. Some of our strongest progress has come through events, introductions and face-to-face relationships in China. We now want to turn that early traction into a more consistent commercial channel. Role and scope This is a hands-on commercial role focused on building Gocertify's presence with Chinese brands. You'll own the China new-business pipeline from identifying the right brands and opening conversations through to demo, negotiation and close. A big part of the role is building relationships directly with Chinese businesses, both remotely and during regular time in China. You'll stay close to new partners through launch where your Mandarin, market knowledge or existing relationship helps, before Client Success takes over the ongoing relationship. This isn't a mature territory with a fixed playbook. You'll build your own pipeline, win Chinese brands and help us work out the most effective way to grow Gocertify in China. As our first full-time commercial hire focused on China, you'll also help shape how we approach the market as we learn what works. What you will focus on 1. Build a pipeline of Chinese brands You will work on Building and prioritising a target list of Chinese consumer brands with strong UK or international growth potential Creating new opportunities through outbound, WeChat, LinkedIn, email, events, introductions and relevant partner networks Finding and building relationships with the right contacts Using time in China to meet priority brands in person, attend relevant industry events and develop relationships that are harder to build remotely Testing which brands, messages and channels generate the strongest opportunities and adjusting your approach based on what works 2. Help build a stronger China go-to-market You will work on Sharing what you are learning about Chinese brands, buying processes, objections and competitors Improving how we position and sell Gocertify in the Chinese market Building useful Mandarin-language sales materials, case studies and other assets where they will help opportunities progress Identifying which events, networks, partners and routes into the market are producing the strongest results Turning what works into a more repeatable approach as our China business grows 4

jobs.description: Position Summary The Logistics Coordinator will manage retailer purchase orders and coordinate shipment preparation, documentation, tracking, and fulfillment, with a primary focus on Walmart. The role will maintain accurate order records, support retailer compliance and claims resolution, and coordinate with production, shipping, warehouse, and operations teams. Following initial client-led training, the role will report to the Operations Manager and Director of Operations. Job Details: Work Setup: Work from home Shift/Schedule: Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM U.S. Central Time | 9:00 PM - 6:00 AM Manila Time Holidays: Follow the client's holiday calendar, to be provided Responsibilities: Manage the retail order desk by retrieving, reviewing, and processing retailer purchase orders (POs), including Walmart POs. Access retailer portals and EDI platforms, including Walmart Retail Link, to manage orders and maintain product information. Enter and update PO, shipment, and delivery details in Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, and internal order-management records. Set up shipments in Walmart's transportation system, review assigned shipment information, and create and maintain shipment tickets. Prepare Bills of Lading (BOLs), retailer-compliant shipping and pallet labels, ASN labels/stickers, and other required shipping documentation. Upload complete shipment documentation to Google Drive and email the production team with the files needed for printing and shipment preparation. Check that products and shipments meet retailer-specific labeling, pallet, ASN, routing, and compliance requirements. Coordinate retailer routing requirements and communicate appointment information to the internal team.
