Track shipment and delivery status, obtain Proofs of Delivery (PODs), and maintain accurate PO, shipment, BOL, and delivery records. Monitor retailer claims and discrepancies, research supporting shipment records, and file and process claims for shipments or products reported as missing or not received. Identify potential On-Time In-Full (OTIF) and retailer compliance issues and proactively communicate them to the appropriate internal teams. Check retailer inventory information and store-level product stock when required. Use Walmart Scintilla as the source of truth for U.S. supplier performance, including in-store sales and online pickup/delivery performance. Support reporting and analysis on retailer sales, inventory, fulfillment, and compliance using retailer reporting systems and internal records. Coordinate proactively with production, shipping, warehouse, and operations teams to resolve order issues and support timely fulfillment. Qualifications: 2+ years of logistics coordination, retail order processing, or related experience. Ability to use Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets to maintain accurate purchase order, shipment, and delivery records. Good written and verbal communication skill s for coordinating with client contacts and internal operations teams. Strong attention to detail and organizational skills when managing order information, shipping documents, and retailer records. Ability to investigate shipment discrepancies, follow up on missing information, and raise potential fulfillment or compliance issues promptly. Willingness and ability to learn retailer-specific systems and processes; training will be provided. Experience with Walmart systems, including Retail Link, Walmart transportation tools, and Scintilla, is a strong advantage but is not required. Familiarity with EDI platforms, retailer shipping documentation, and OTIF requirements is an advantage. Originally posted on Himalayas

Strong understanding of RFP/RFI/RFQ and government procurement processes, including the FAR and relevant state/local procurement regulations. jobs.title: Account Executive (West Coast)
jobs.description: About Us Eterio Realities Inc. is a software company in Victoria, British Columbia, building augmented reality tools for industrial manufacturing. Our story began in 2010, out of challenges encountered during the construction of the Sparkling Hill Resort in Vernon, B.C. Today our team of 30+ people across Canada, India and growing! We have built FabStation , an AR-enabled manufacturing execution system used by 250+ fabrication shops in 30+ countries. FabStation replaces paper and 2D drawings on the shop floor with AR-guided assembly, dimensional inspection, and production tracking, and it integrates with the workflows shops already run. Our mission is to empower steel fabricators with innovative augmented reality technology, revolutionizing the way they work. The Role We are looking for a self-motivated Account Executive (West Coast) selling into the global structural steel and pre-fab markets. This is a full-cycle sales role, taking the prospective clients from initial outreach through to sign off with a focus on exploring new industries to introduce FabStation . You are organized and have exceptional verbal and written communication skills. We’re seeking an individual with an entrepreneurial spirit who has a strong sense of self-development and accountability. The Account Executive should exude diplomacy, tact, and poise under pressure when working with clients at their work site and/or at trade shows and various other events in and out of the country. What You Will Do Obtain an expert-level understanding of our existing products and develop an understanding of our new products. Identify and qualify new prospective clients via phone, social media, and email. Develop and manage your sales pipeline through HubSpot. Scheduling online demonstrations with both warm and cold opportunities. Conduct online and in-person demos using open questions to understand the clients' pain points and deliver our value proposition. Build and nurture relationships with key decision-makers within target organizations. Negotiate agreement terms, and close deals to meet or exceed sales targets. Track and report on key sales metrics to measure performance and identify areas for improvement. Facilitate a smooth transition from sales to customer success teams, ensuring all client expectations are documented and communicated. Be attentive to client concerns and provide answers that are knowledgeable and insightful to encourage product sales and retention. Travel to conferences, trade shows, and customers where required. What We’re Looking For 3+ years' experience in the construction/manufacturing industry OR 5+ years’ of technical sales experience, preferably within the SaaS industry Proven track record of hitting sales targets and quotas Experience in full-cycle sales processes, including lead generation, prospecting, outreach, negotiation and closing Experience in consultative selling and understanding customer needs Exceptional English verbal and written communication skills Experience with CRM platforms. HubSpot would be a bonus Competitive, self-motivated, and results-driven mindset Organized and able to manage high activity volume Highly organized with strong follow-through and attention to detail Fast learner who can quickly understand technical products and manufacturing workflows Ability to confidently communicate value to executives, sales leaders, and operational teams Exposure to manufacturing, construction, or technical products is highly preferred What We Offer Competitive compensation: $50,000-65,000 plus commission ($106,400 - $176,400 OTE) Competitive benefits 2 weeks paid vacation plus 5 paid sick days Annual company offsite $2,000 CAD tech stipend Fully remote work environment Company-wide holiday week closure over Christmas Continuous coaching for career growth Salary: $106,400 – $176,400 / year Originally posted on Himalayas

jobs.title: Senior 3D Animators (Madrid)
jobs.description: Flying Bark Productions is a dynamic and innovative animation studio dedicated to pushing the boundaries of character animation and storytelling. We are working on exciting projects such as Avatar: The Last Airbender feature film, Netflix's Ghostbusters animated series and Stranger Things animated series as well as upcoming feature film, Zac Power. We are looking for candidates that can work remotely and you must be based in Spain or Europe. The Senior 3D Animator is responsible for bringing life to the characters of the project, with an emphasis on enhancing the story and audience connection with the characters and narrative. Additionally, working to, and maintaining, the creative and technical requirements for animation for the project as required by the Animation Director; and to the production and shot schedule provided by the Production Company. About you: Minimum requirement of 6+ years production experience in 3D animated films and/or animated episodic; Demo Reels showcasing excellent facial performance & body mechanics; Portfolios with mature, stylized and anime-inspired animation preferred. 2D animation experience is a bonus but non-essential for this role. Somewhat in the vein of Spiderverse, Entergalactic, Arcane and The Witness [Love, Death, Robots]; Good sense of narrative storytelling, comic timing and emotive visual language; Excellent experience with character animation including lip sync and key posing in a CG animation environment; Some experience in Rigging would be a benefit; Solid experience and understanding of Maya in a production based environment; Solid knowledge of animation workflows, character rigs and storyboard interpretation; Experience creating animated sequences of characters, objects, and cameras, Able to collaborate with the animation team to achieve the EPs vision Proficient with keyframe animation and have strong fundamentals such as posing, timing, and pacing; Ability to rough out animation blocking for review, then revise and polish to completion; Strong understanding of the principles of animation; Passion for animation and storytelling. Ability to take direction from a Supervisor and be team oriented; Ability to take feedback from director and lead animator and apply to shots accordingly; Ability to take and successfully interpret a verbal or visual creative brief; Excellent communication skills and willingness to share information in a team environment; Ability to consistently meet deadlines; Ability to take direction and be flexible and responsive to change; Ability to work independently as well as under direct supervision; Fast problem solving and implementation of solutions. Excellent English communication skills, both written and verbal; Eligible to work in Spain. Spanish locals will be given priority. What do we do? Flying Bark Productions is a renowned independent producer of family-focused animation entertainment. For over 50 years, our 2D and 3D production facility has created award-winning feature films and TV series. Why work with us? We work on some pretty cool projects - check out our website: We love dogs and you will often see some of our regular fluffy companions in the studio. We have a hybrid approach to work. For this particular position, full remote could be an option. Career development is important to us so we offer training and support opportunities whenever possible. Our employees say our culture is the best they've ever experienced - everyone is welcome and celebrated! Flying Bark Productions is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. Originally posted on Himalayas
